LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsDeliverTree_Report: The quartermaster has arrived to inspect and collect the consignment.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Deliver_Greeting: "We meet at last, {Interviewer_labelShort}. I am the quartermaster sent to inspect the arms you've forged for the kingdom. Show me your work."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Deliver_OptDeliver: Deliver the weapons (3 longswords of Good or better quality)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Deliver_OptLater: Hold on, the goods aren't ready yet
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Deliver_Thanks: The quartermaster inspects each blade, nods in satisfaction, then hands over a pouch of silver and a sealed scroll. "This is the royal writ of conscription. Use it once, and once only. When you are in dire need, invoke it—our forces will come to your aid."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Deliver_MsgPaid: You have delivered the qualified arms. In return, you received silver and a royal writ of conscription.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_NeedQuality: You do not have enough qualified weapons on hand—you need 3 longswords of 'Good' quality or better.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Aid_NoFaction: You attempted to invoke the writ, but there is no Rakinian faction capable of responding, or your relations have soured beyond repair.
